'''Kloo''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] member of the [[Organization]] working on the [[Darkside (space station)|Darkside]] station. He spent some quality time in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] incarcerated in cells on [[Tolea Biqua]].
